description.value: Silkway Halal Cuisine is a halal-certified Chinese restaurant in Richmond, BC, serving a community with significant demand for halal dining options. It offers a notable combination of Chinese cuisine and halal preparation, making it one of relatively few options in the region catering to both culinary traditions. Touring cyclists passing through Richmond's food-rich corridors may find this a convenient and distinctive stop.
